note: RFC 4271 Section 6.3 requires Error Subcode 10 (Invalid Network Field) for syntactically invalid NLRI; RFC 7606 Section 3(i) applies the same check to Withdrawn Routes and Section 3(j) retains session reset. TestSessionRFC4271RetainedUpdateNotifications verifies prefix length > 32, truncated NLRI, and truncated Withdrawn Routes each return an error, send NOTIFICATION 3/10 with empty Data, and enter Idle, while a valid prefix on the same session is accepted and delivered.
